# guaman-poma fixtures

Four real pages of the Royal Danish Library's digital edition of Guaman
Poma, El primer nueva corónica y buen gobierno (GKS 2232 4º), whole and
byte-identical, retrieved 2026-10-11 from the stable permalinks
`https://poma.kb.dk/permalink/2006/poma/<id>/es/text/`:

| file | page | why |
|---|---|---|
| `titlepage.html` | the title page (p. 0) | Drawing 1, `[portada]`, the navigation's last-page arrow (`>|` → 1189) and the full table of contents (highest linked page 1188) — the PomaFetch manifest test reads it |
| `5.html` | p. 5 | a letter: the letter-keyed gloss line, the edition's Andean-terms line (`/ qhapaq apu / qhapaq /`), commentary notes |
| `319.html` | p. 319 (Guaman Poma's 317) | the songs: Quechua and Aymara verse in italics, the editors' paragraph-long translations (`span.trans`), the normalized-songs line |
| `1189.html` | p. 1189 | the last page: Drawing 398, Guaman Poma's own pagination "s.n." |

License: the Library's project page (poma.kb.dk/permalink/2006/poma/
info/es/project/project.htm, read 2026-10-11), verbatim: "Esta obra ha
sido identificada como libre de restricciones conocidas bajo la ley
